actions.body: Recent investigations into autonomous architectures reveal that artificial agents require endogenous values and open-ended learning mechanisms to acquire flexible skills without continuous human supervision. Summary: Autonomous agents can independently formulate goals and sustain investigations when equipped with open-ended learning structures.
